sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def objs(f, color, minrow=15):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if min(rs)>=minrow:
                out.append(f"rows{min(rs)}-{max(rs)} cols{min(cs)}-{max(cs)} px{n['pixels']}")
    return out
print("brush(p) now:", objs(current_frame,'p'))
print("white now:   ", objs(current_frame,'W'))
# paint with SPACE in left-diamond state
r=action(['SPACE'])
print("after SPACE:")
print("brush(p):", objs(current_frame,'p'))
print("white:   ", objs(current_frame,'W'))
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
